name: Setiptiline
summary: Setiptiline is an antidepressant related to mirtazapine, sold in Japan as Tecipul for major depression. It is not approved in the United States or Europe.
description: Setiptiline is a tetracyclic antidepressant (TeCA) related to mirtazapine, sold in Japan under the brand name Tecipul. It is used there to treat major depressive disorder and related depressive conditions. It works like mirtazapine: it blocks certain brain receptors (alpha-2) so that more norepinephrine and serotonin are released, and it also blocks some serotonin receptors (5-HT2, 5-HT3) and histamine H1 receptors. It is not approved in the United States or Europe.
